config.customInstructionPath.markdownDes: Custom file path *(only used when Instruction File is set to 'custom')*
config.skillsDirectory.description: Directory to install and manage workspace skills
config.useVsCodeAgentSkillLocations.desc: Also discover standard personal skill roots and extra user/global skills from VS Code Agent Skill Locations
config.useVsCodeAgentSkillLocations.mark: Discover managed skill roots from standard personal locations (`~/.copilot/skills`, `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`) and from VS Code Agent Skill Locations settings. Configured paths support `${workspaceFolder}`, `${userHome}`, `${env:NAME}`, and `%NAME%`.
config.showBuiltInSkills.description: Show read-only built-in skills from Copilot / VS Code assets, separate from installed extension skills, grouped by provider/origin
config.showBuiltInSkills.markdownDescrip: Show built-in skills as a separate read-only scope in the User / Global Skills view, distinct from read-only skills discovered from installed extensions. Group built-in entries by provider/origin and then by variant/root. These entries can be opened, but not installed, edited, or uninstalled.
config.autoUpdateInstruction.description: Automatically update instruction file on install/uninstall
config.autoUpdateInstruction.markdownDes: **Automatically update instruction file** (AGENTS.md etc.) on skill install/uninstall
config.autoUpdateSkillsOnUpgrade.markdow:
**Update installed skills** when extension is upgraded

- `always`: Automatically reinstall all skills
- `prompt`: Ask before updating
- `never`: Do not update
config.staleSourceIndexUpdateMode.markdo:
**Update stale source repository indexes** on startup when a source has not been indexed for more than 30 days. This does not affect extension-upgrade skill reinstall behavior.

- `always`: Automatically update stale source indexes
- `prompt`: Ask before updating *(default)*
- `never`: Do not check or update stale source indexes
config.staleSourceIndexUpdateMode.always: Always - Automatically update stale source indexes
config.staleSourceIndexUpdateMode.prompt: Prompt - Ask before updating stale source indexes
config.staleSourceIndexUpdateMode.never: Never - Do not check stale source indexes
config.includeLocalSkills.description: Deprecated: workspace skills are managed from the skills directory only
config.includeLocalSkills.markdownDescri: Deprecated. Workspace skills are managed from the configured Skills Directory only; SKILL.md files outside that directory are not auto-detected.
config.additionalSkillRoots.description: Additional workspace skill root directories to discover
config.additionalSkillRoots.markdownDesc: **Additional Workspace Skill Roots** — Extra workspace skill root directories to discover in addition to `#skillNinja.skillsDirectory#`. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`, `${userHome}`, `${env:NAME}`, and `%NAME%`. Example: `["copilot-skills/skills", "copilot-skills/m-skills"]`.
config.githubToken.description: Legacy GitHub Personal Access Token setting for API requests, private source repositories, and higher rate limits
config.githubToken.markdownDescription: Legacy GitHub Personal Access Token setting for API requests, private source repositories, and higher rate limits. This setting is machine-scoped, so it cannot be stored in workspace settings. If set, Agent Skills Ninja copies it to VS Code SecretStorage and uses the secure copy first. Prefer environment variables (`GH_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN`) or gh CLI authentication; if you use a PAT, prefer a fine-grained token with selected repositories and `Contents: read`.
config.outputFormat.markdownDescription:
**🌟 Output Format** - How skills are written to the instruction file (default: `ref`).

| Value | Instruction file | Catalog file |
|-------|-----------------|--------------|
| `ref` | Lightweight IMPORTANT + link | Separate file, format set by `refCatalogFormat` |
| `full` | IMPORTANT + full table | — |
| `compact` | IMPORTANT + compressed index | — |
| `legacy` | Simple table only | — |

When `ref` is selected, also configure `#skillNinja.refCatalogPath#` and `#skillNinja.refCatalogFormat#`.
config.outputFormat.ref: 🔗 Ref *(Default)* - Lightweight IMPORTANT + catalog link only; detailed catalog in a separate file
config.refCatalogPath.markdownDescriptio: **📂 Ref Catalog File Path** *(used when Output Format is `ref`)* — Path to the separate catalog file (default: `.github/skills/README.md`). Workspace-relative paths resolve from the workspace root; for user/global roots they resolve from the instruction file directory. The file is created automatically.
config.refCatalogFormat.markdownDescript: **📋 Ref Catalog Format** *(used when Output Format is `ref`)* — Format written inside the catalog file. `full` (default) writes the detailed table; `compact` writes the compressed index; `legacy` writes the simple compatibility table. See `#skillNinja.outputFormat#`.
config.singleClickInstall.description: Install skills with single click in Browse view instead of double-clicking a row
config.singleClickInstall.markdownDescri: **Single-click Install** — Install remote skills with a single click in the Remote Skills view. When disabled *(default)*, double-click is required. Context-menu install always works regardless of this setting.

config.companionExtension.markdownDescri:
### 🧩 Companion Extension

[Agent Resources Ninja](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=yamapan.agent-resources-ninja) - Resource-oriented companion extension for managing skills plus agents, prompts, instructions, hooks, MCP config resources, and related AI coding resources. [GitHub](https://github.com/aktsmm/vscode-agent-resources-ninja)
config.coexistenceMode.markdownDescripti:
**Coexistence Mode** with the Agent Resources Ninja extension.

- `auto` (default): Single shared instruction block (`<!-- agent-ninja-START/END -->`). When Resources Ninja is also active, it owns the block and Skill Ninja defers (no parallel blocks).
- `independent`: Legacy behavior. Always write the `<!-- skill-ninja-START/END -->` marker block regardless of Resources Ninja. Allows parallel blocks (advanced).
config.useSharedSourcesManifest.markdown: Share the remote source list SSOT with Agent Resources Ninja via `~/.agent-ninja/sources.json`. When enabled, add/remove source changes stay aligned across both extensions. This shares source definitions only; each extension still refreshes its own index content.
